roof_vertex_rule: p=input triangle[0], q=input triangle[1], r=input triangle[2]; swap q/r if exact XY cross is negative, so p/q/r are counterclockwise in XY
parent_face_rule: For source==0: input roof row=source_face//8; local face=source_face%8; original source face ID=input NPZ source_face_ids[input roof row]. For all ambiguous parents apply this rule separately to each CSR parent in this leaf.
ambiguity: all_parent_offsets/all_parent_faces retain every exact original triangle containing the child. The primary source_face is only the minimum parent index. The final snap autorefine_input_face links its child to the original pre-snap face row and therefore to its complete parent CSR.
orientation_rule: For EVERY parent match, reconstruct its oriented triangle by this schema or the exact mask/part/bbox input triangles. Compute sign(dot(cross(child1-child0,child2-child0),cross(parent1-parent0,parent2-parent0))) in exact rational coordinates; use result.mesh64.exact for native child coordinates. Nonzero child and parent guarantee sign is +/-1 when coplanar. Preserve conflicting roles/signs. No interface/contact decision may use only the minimum primary parent.
parentage_scope: Geometric convex-triangle containment, not a causal algorithm visitor trace. A parent witness proves surface containment; physical contact classification requires all relevant parent roles, orientations and independent material-side checks.
